## Appearance

Leslie Moore is a striking figure with a beautiful face and sea-blue eyes full of laughter and allurement. She possesses long, splendid hair that gleams like molten gold and falls all about her to her feet. Contrasting with her brilliant hair, her slender, work-hardened hands are brown from labor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P16](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P38](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0038), +1 more_

## Personality

Leslie Moore is a resolute individual with a strong sense of duty, though she is not particularly socially inclined. Beneath this demeanor lies a glowing, pent-up personality that occasionally finds expression in remarkable talents, such as dancing with extraordinary rhythmic grace. Driven by a deep longing for motherhood, she once expressed a willingness to trade her life for the experience of having a child. Looking toward her future, she plans to study nursing in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal), while also preparing to marry Owen at [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), +2 more_

## History

Leslie Moore faced early tragedy, discovering her father after he committed suicide at age fourteen, and at sixteen she was coerced into marrying [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) to save her mother's farm from foreclosure. A year later, her mother passed away. After meeting her neighbor [Anne](../character/anne.md) [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) on the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), Leslie formed a close, lasting friendship with her, eventually overcoming initial bitterness and confessing her painful past and complex feelings during a heart-to-heart in the garden. She hosted writer [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) as a summer boarder, and during his stay, she secretly fell in love with him while maintaining her devotion to her household duties. When [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed a brain operation that might restore Dick's memory, Leslie decided to proceed with the procedure and traveled to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal). The operation revealed that her dependent husband was actually Dick's cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), freeing her from her long burden when George's sister took him home. Returning to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), Leslie stayed with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to help around the house and reconnected with [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) upon his return. They confessed their mutual love in the garden and became engaged. After receiving Captain Jim's blessing shortly before his peaceful death, Leslie looked forward to a future with Owen, who arranged to purchase [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Gilbert's home as a summer residence.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P2](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P3](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P6](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P7](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), +516 more_

## Quotes

> "I knew who YOU were, although I had never seen either of you before. I had heard of the new doctor and his bride who were coming to live in Miss Russell’s little house. I—I hated you that very moment, Anne."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P19](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0019)

> "She is mistaken—or prejudiced. I think my figure IS better—mother was slight and bent by hard work—but she had the face of an angel. I used just to look up at her in worship. We all worshipped her,—father and Kenneth and I."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P37](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0037)

> “Kenneth was my brother,” went on Leslie. “Oh, I can’t tell you how I loved him. And he was cruelly killed. Do you know how?”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P39](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0039)

> "Anne, I saw his little face as the wheel went over him. He fell on his back. Anne—Anne—I can see it now. I shall always see it. Anne, all I ask of heaven is that that recollection shall be blotted out of my memory. O my God!"
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P41](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0041)

> "I can’t tell you—don’t ask me. I wouldn’t mind your knowing—I wish you did know—but I can’t tell you—I can’t tell anyone. I’ve been such a fool, Anne—and oh, it hurts so terribly to be a fool. There’s nothing so painful in the world."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P11](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie and [Anne](../character/anne.md) first met as mysterious neighbors during an evening walk along the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), agreeing to exchange visits. They developed a close bond through fireside gatherings, evening rambles, and tramping together. Although Leslie initially harbored lingering distance and bitter envy due to her own tragic history, her confession of these past feelings cleared the air and cemented a much deeper, lasting friendship between them.

- Comrade of — rambles and fireside communings  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002)</sub>
- Friend of — neighbors and tramping companions  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P30](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), +8 more</sub>

### [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carlo--leslie-moore.md)

[Carlo](../character/carlo.md) was Leslie's faithful dog who provided her with immense comfort and companionship. Following his death, Leslie deeply mourned his loss while enduring a period of intense personal grief and confusion.

- Friend of — faithful dog companion and comfort to her  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026)</sub>

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

[Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) is a caring friend and neighbor to Leslie who takes a protective interest in her well-being. Knowing Leslie's [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) faith and tragic past, [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) actively encouraged [Anne](../character/anne.md) to persist in being a friend to Leslie despite her initial cold demeanor. [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) also keeps track of local gossip involving Leslie, including arranging for a summer boarder at Leslie's home.

- Friend of — caring friend and neighbor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), +1 more</sub>

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie was bound in a painful marriage to the man she believed to be her tragic husband, [Dick](../character/dick.md), whom she dutifully cared for despite the heavy emotional toll it took on her. This situation caused her immense grief, weeping, and feelings of envy toward happier neighbors like [Anne](../character/anne.md). The relationship ultimately ended when an operation revealed that the man she had been caring for was actually Dick's cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that the real [Dick](../character/dick.md) had died years prior.

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +9 more</sub>

[The First Mate](../character/first-mate.md) is Captain Jim's beloved pet living at the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse. ### [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-moore--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie cared for [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) for years under the tragic mistaken belief that he was her husband, [Dick](../character/dick.md), due to their striking resemblance. After taking him to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for an operation, his memory returned and revealed his true identity, leading to his sister taking him home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) while Leslie kept in touch with him through letter correspondence.
